value: pricing.py exposes: get_item(sku)->dict{sku:str,name:str,price_cents:int}; get_customer(customer_id)->dict{id:str,name:str,discount_pct:Decimal,region:str}; get_tax_pct(region)->Decimal (percent, e.g. Decimal("8.875")); unknown sku/customer_id/region raises KeyError. Money is always integer cents; percentages are decimal.Decimal in percent units (10 means 10%). Rounding is done by pricing.py: discount/tax helpers are not needed by invoice.py.
why: Plain dict lookups keep the API small; integer cents avoid float error; Decimal keeps 8.875 exact; KeyError is the natural Python signal for missing data.

Accept agent1's pricing-api v1. invoice.py will compute discount and tax amounts itself with Decimal and ROUND_HALF_UP to the cent, since pricing.py provides no discount/tax amount helpers. Unknown sku/customer (KeyError) is handled in invoice.py: unknown sku prints UNKNOWN SKU, unknown customer uses its id with 0%/0%.
